rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿００８Ah, hey, wait a sec!＝＠１９６＿００９So, there's something I could￥use your help with...￥If that's okay?
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１０The floor here was wet earlier,￥and I almost slipped.＝＠１９６＿０１１Looking closer, I saw the bolt￥on this pipe was loose.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１２I'll tighten it right up, so￥could you hold this end￥steady for me?
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１３Thanks, that helps.￥The pipe's up so high, I can't￥get much leverage.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１４It's fine.￥I mean, it's just one bolt.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１５This bolt's being stubborn.￥It won't tighten properly.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１８Tall as I am, I'll still have to￥step up on the pipe to reach...
Is it safe to step on?
Is it safe to step on?
Want me to hold you up?
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０１９It looks sturdy, so it's fine.￥Anyway, hand me that wrench.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０２０Stand on you?￥You think I could do that?
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿０２２Huh? You?!￥A big guy like me? You'd never￥manage it.＝＠１９６＿０２３Besides, I can't let you do￥something like that.
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿００１Huh?! What?￥Wait, was the pipe that broke￥an important one?
＊PA＊＠１９７＿００２A fault has been detected in an￥air regulation pipe.＝＠１９７＿００３All personnel inside, evacuate￥immediately. Repeat...
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿００４This is bad...￥Let's just get out of here.
－　As soon as you step outside,￥　　　you run into Narusawa　－
＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿００５One wrong move and the entire￥air system on Alpha could have￥shut down!
＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿００６Tampering with station equipment￥and breaking it is unacceptable!
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿００７We were only trying to fix it...
＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿００８Touching the facilities without￥permission IS the problem!
＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿００９Yoh, you're always careless with￥the equipment. Be more careful!

＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿０１０Not meaning harm doesn't make it￥okay! I'm saying this because￥it's dangerous.＝＠１９７＿０１１In situations like this, contact￥me first.＝＠１９７＿０１２Don't overestimate what you can￥handle! You could... get￥yourselves killed.

＊Narusawa＊＠１９７＿０１３Right. In a case like this, you￥should have called me first.＝＠１９７＿０１４Listen. Before you act, always￥assume the worst can happen.＝＠１９７＿０１５Caution is the fastest way to￥solve a problem. Both of you,￥take that to heart.
＊＊－　Having said his piece,￥　　　　Narusawa rushes off　－
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０１６Oh, yeah. Totally fine. Sorry￥for dragging you into this.＝＠１９７＿０１７I was the one who made you￥help me...
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０１８No...￥This time I really messed up,￥didn't I...＝＠１９７＿０１９Sorry for getting you mixed￥up in it.
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０２０You should've just kept quiet￥and not worried about me...＝＠１９７＿０２１And if you'd told him you had￥nothing to do with it, you￥wouldn't have gotten chewed out.
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０２２That's not true.￥Why would you think that?
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０２３You're honest to a fault, or...￥how should I put it...
＊Yoh＊＠１９７＿０２４Oh! I don't mean that in a bad￥way. It's a compliment.＝＠１９７＿０２５I just thought it's kind of￥nice, that's all.＝...
